PurposeFounder-level review board for planned versus realized trade economics, margin variance drivers, claim and recovery leakage, and the actions needed to protect future trade profitability.
Source ruleUpdate deal, shipment, collections, pricing governance, claims recovery, cash forecast, allocation, and profitability-review source records first, then refresh this board.
Decision ruleDo not treat revenue as healthy until pricing guardrails, release timing, cash quality, claim recovery, and realized economics all support the same profitability answer.
